changeSet.author: muw-ophthalmology
changeSet.comment: Mark every e2e-accepting imaging modality as an OCT modality (kinds_accepted += oct).
changeSet.sql: UPDATE imaging_modality SET kinds_accepted = kinds_accepted || ',oct' WHERE (',' || lower(COALESCE(kinds_accepted, '')) || ',') LIKE '%,e2e,%' AND (',' || lower(COALESCE(kinds_accepted, '')) || ',') NOT LIKE '%,oct,%';

rollback.sql: UPDATE imaging_modality SET kinds_accepted = trim(BOTH ',' FROM replace(',' || kinds_accepted || ',', ',oct,', ',')) WHERE (',' || lower(COALESCE(kinds_accepted, '')) || ',') LIKE '%,oct,%';
